topic: An old family photo where one new face appears in the background every night.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: One More Face

shots.narration: Every night, another face appeared in our old family photo.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated film look; a Pakistani haveli courtyard at night, an old framed photograph between Bashir and Saad, no writing anywhere.
shots.action: Bashir turns the framed photograph toward Saad.
shots.mood: Brass lantern glow, blue moonlight, drifting fog, deep courtyard shadows.

shots.narration: Bashir Chacha told me what happened inside his family's haveli.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; courtyard beside a carved wooden door, Bashir in his brown shawl and white cap, Saad in his dark green hoodie.
shots.action: Bashir points toward the dark haveli doorway.
shots.mood: Warm lantern light against a cold, silent doorway.

shots.narration: [whispers] The photograph showed me alone, beside my family's empty chairs.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; flashback inside a dusty Pakistani haveli sitting room, close view of an aged family photograph showing only Bashir among empty carved chairs, no writing.
shots.action: Bashir hangs the photograph on a bare plaster wall.
shots.mood: Faded sepia photograph, weak lantern light, long furniture shadows.

shots.narration: The first night, another face appeared behind my chair.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; close view of the framed photograph, its pictured Bashir seated among empty chairs.
shots.action: A second image of Bashir's face materializes behind the pictured chair.
shots.mood: A pale face emerging from sepia darkness, faint amber reflections.

shots.narration: It was my face, wearing a smile I never made.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; extreme close view of the photograph's background duplicate of Bashir, grey beard and white cap clearly visible.
shots.action: The duplicate Bashir's mouth curls into a wide smile.
shots.mood: Unnatural stillness, dim sepia light, dark eyes beneath the cap.

shots.narration: [sighs] The next night, three of me watched the empty room.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; the same haveli wall on a later night, photograph containing the seated Bashir and two background duplicates.
shots.action: Bashir raises his brass lantern toward the three pictured faces.
shots.mood: Three matching smiles, wavering lantern glow, heavy surrounding darkness.

shots.narration: Each night added another, closer to the edge.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; tight view of the aged photograph, several duplicate Bashir faces crowded behind the original seated figure.
shots.action: One new Bashir face fades into view beside the frame's inner edge.
shots.mood: Cramped composition, overlapping white caps, unsettling sepia shadows.

shots.narration: I turned the photograph toward the wall.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; dusty haveli sitting room, framed photograph on a narrow wooden table beneath peeling plaster.
shots.action: Bashir turns the frame face-first against the wall.
shots.mood: Lantern-lit hands, opaque darkness beneath the table, tense quiet.

shots.narration: [whispers] At midnight, it turned back by itself.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; the narrow wooden table, Bashir motionless in the distant doorway, the frame resting against the wall.
shots.action: The framed photograph pivots to face the room.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, thin floor fog, a small isolated lantern glow.

shots.narration: Now every face crowded against the glass.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; close view of the photograph, its chairs obscured by tightly packed duplicate Bashir faces.
shots.action: Bashir leans toward the crowded photograph.
shots.mood: Lantern reflections across glass, compressed smiling faces, almost black surroun

shots.narration: Then one pushed against the glass, from inside.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; extreme close view of the framed photograph, a duplicate Bashir directly behind the glass.
shots.action: The pictured Bashir presses his face outward, bowing the glass.
shots.mood: Distorted smiling face, stretched lantern reflection, deep darkness behind the f

shots.narration: [whispers] Tonight, Saad, it shows you waiting at an abandoned station.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16; back in the courtyard by Bashir's lantern, the photograph now showing only Saad on a foggy railway platform with blank walls and no signs.
shots.action: Saad lifts the changed photograph into the lantern light.
shots.mood: Saad's startled face above his photographed double, amber light surrounded by bl

episode.endHook: Why does the next photograph show Saad at an abandoned railway station?
episode.description: By lantern light, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about an old family photograph that changed every night. Each new face looked strangely familiar. A fictional spooky story from Midnight Watch.
